parts.text: Trigger a full Chronos Frame Agent workflow cycle to retrieve top 5 headlines and generate smart frame image.
Generate a 90s lo-fi anime Vivid Retro-Pop smart frame image for morning news (08:00).
Generate an Electric Claymation 90s lo-fi anime smart frame image for midday news (13:00).
Generate a Luminescent Lo-Fi Digital smart frame image for evening news (20:00).
Publish consecutive images and verify the 3-image FIFO queue removes older items.
